notes: not_supported is returned by host dispatch for the remaining extra_host_json names, but it is not a member of the WIT error-code enum. Recorded here; no new error code was added to the frozen ABI.
setting_get is an ext-layer hand-written import: the WIT package stays frozen and the host call uses the C-style (key_ptr, len, out_ptr, cap) shape recorded in the 03 ABI table.

setting_watch is an ext-layer hand-written import with no WIT signature. It records a per-connection settings watch; operator writes then deliver settings_changed with payload {"key":"<key>"}. It returns not_supported when the host port has no settings store.
conformance_expects records the outcome of the function's primary happy-path conformance vector; error-path vectors do not change it.
wasm_symbol is the native symbol registered in cmd/app-host/main.c and whitelisted in foundation/src/edge_wasm_imports.c. null means the function has no wasm import yet.
